description: Upgrade the Kafka version of a CDSS cluster (rolling restart; cannot be downgraded). Run ncloud_cdss_upgrade_precheck first. Use dryRun=true to preview; executing requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute — the upgrade cannot be rolled back

dryRun.description: Preview the request without sending it

upgradeConfigGroupNo.description: Config group number for the target version (from ncloud_cdss_list_config_groups)

name: ncloud_cdss_upgrade_version
